svg.title: Three zones on one large loss
svg.desc: Isometric floor plan of a motel wing split into three containment zones, each with air scrubbers ducted outside, joined to the exit by a two-stage decontamination chamber.
svg.text: Three zones on one large loss
6 working + 1 spare = 7 of your 8 scrubbers. Each zone has its own barriers, manometer and entry.
Sequence: A, then B, then C, working back towards the exit. Blue film = critical barriers.
CARSI · Level 3 Mould Remediation · schematic, not to scale
